text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
After so much support from everyone
and all the
work you put into training
me, I really wanted to
live up to your
expectations...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
choice_data_list: 挑戦し続けることが大事
次のレースで応えてほしい

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'm never able to clinch
victory,
everyone still supports me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's why I can't give up! I have to push
on and
come in first next time!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! You're already thinking about
what comes
next for me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That means I have to keep moving
forward! I'll win
next time and meet
everyone's expectations!
